test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between Q and S, when counted from the right of Q. Only one person sits between S and C. Only one person sits between Q and R. Only two people sit between A and C. Only one person sits between B and R. Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only one person sits between Q and S, when counted from the right of Q.
 
• Only one person sits between S and C.
 
• Only one person sits between Q and R.
 
• Only two people sit between A and C.
 
• Only one person sits between B and R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66065646f9c3d0d2fa15640de676538b0f74b49fc699d9798611a48d034bfad9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
